modern_c2_q7.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    guy_patches = image_patch.find("guy")
    polo_patches = image_patch.find("polo")
    
    if not guy_patches or not polo_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    polo_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in polo_patches]
    guy_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2, (p.lower + p.upper) / 2 for p in guy_patches]
    
    closest_polo = min(polo_centers, key=lambda pc: sum((pc[i] - gc[i]) ** 2 for i in range(2)))
    closest_guy = min(guy_centers, key=lambda gc: sum((gc[i] - cp[i]) ** 2 for i in range(2)))
    
    guy_patch = guy_patches[guy_centers.index(closest_guy)]
    polo_patch = polo_patches[polo_centers.index(closest_polo)]
    
    if abs(closest_polo[0] - closest_guy[0]) < abs(closest_polo[1] - closest_guy[1]):
        return guy_patch
    else:
        return polo_patch

modern_c2_q7.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    man_patches = image_patch.find("man")
    fire_suit_patches = image_patch.find("fire suit")
    
    if not man_patches or not fire_suit_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    man_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in man_patches]
    fire_suit_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in fire_suit_patches]
    
    closest_man = min(man_centers, key=lambda x: abs(x - min(fire_suit_centers)))
    closest_man_patch = man_patches[man_centers.index(closest_man)]
    
    return closest_man_patch

modern_c2_q7.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    girl_patches = image_patch.find("girl")
    shirt_patches = image_patch.find("shirt")
    
    if not girl_patches or not shirt_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    girl = girl_patches[0]
    shirt = shirt_patches[0]
    
    if girl.overlaps_with(shirt.left, shirt.lower, shirt.right, shirt.upper):
        return girl
    
    girl_shirt_distance = abs(girl.vertical_center - shirt.vertical_center)
    return girl if girl_shirt_distance < 20 else shirt

modern_c2_ds.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    girl_patches = image_patch.find("girl")
    reddish_patches = image_patch.find("reddish shirt")
    
    if not girl_patches or not reddish_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    # Find the girl with the reddish shirt
    for girl in girl_patches:
        for shirt in reddish_patches:
            if abs(girl.horizontal_center - shirt.horizontal_center) < (girl.right - girl.left) and \
               abs(girl.vertical_center - shirt.vertical_center) < (girl.upper - girl.lower):
                return girl
    
    # If no match, return the first girl found
    return girl_patches[0] if girl_patches else reddish_patches[0]
